regime_context: The China A-shares detector shows Semiconductors as the dominant eligible trending theme, but with very narrow breadth (0.045) and a history where the absolute-trend gate failed to reduce drawdown (mean-reverting tape). Cross-sectional momentum serves only as an attention lens; prior calls here have hit rate 47% and direction accuracy 41%, so any leans must carry low conviction.

theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Semiconductors hold the top momentum rank and meet the absolute-trend eligibility gate, the only scorable theme currently satisfying the trend discipline. However, the gate has historically not helped in this market, so this lean is fragile and owes more to persistence of trend than to any forecast.
theses.dissent: Narrow breadth signals thin leadership; the mean-reverting character of A-shares has historically whipsawed trend followers, and a policy shift or sector rotation could unwind the position rapidly.

falsifier.text: If breadth drops below 0.02 or the theme loses eligibility (trend gate flips) within 10 trading days, the overweight bias is invalidated.

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: The detector flags this theme as crowded (crowding_z=1.13), a sizing caution that warrants avoiding fresh exposure. Trend eligibility remains, but crowding acts as a risk-management yellow card per the guardrails.
theses.dissent: Crowding can persist for extended periods; the theme may continue trending on strong fundamental demand, and avoiding it forfeits potential gains.

falsifier.text: If crowding_z falls below 0.5 and the theme retains trend eligibility, the avoid signal weakens.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
